applicationEvidence.reason: Aruba has no postal-code search key or eligible real postal Polygon/MultiPolygon. Shared runtime/UI tests verify fail-closed area contracts but cannot promote draft planning cells or synthetic AW codes.

reproducibility.visualizationDecision: No chart was added because the authoritative denominator is zero postal codes and zero eligible postal geometry; exact receipts and explicit zero counts communicate the decision without implying a measurable area dataset.
reproducibility.reportDelivery: The repository Markdown country report is the rollout's required durable canonical surface; no MCP analytical-report renderer was callable in this runtime.

limitations: The Post Aruba and UPU statements establish current absence of postal codes; they do not authorize inventing a placeholder code or postal surface.
A copyright notice is not an open data licence, and the reviewed pages publish no reusable postal dataset.
Draft AW country-pack localities, planning cells and test vectors are synthetic planning material and are not Post Aruba assignments.
No browser E2E was run because there is no valid AW postcode input or eligible real AW postal area artifact to render.

The UPU page rendered successfully, but the local image-view helper failed with Windows error 206; exact bytes, 12-page count, physical page 4 text markers and non-empty render dimensions were validated.
